name: Rodelbahn Petersberg

sourceFindings.operatorFares: Adult €3 single, child age 3–12 €2.50; per-ride reductions for batches of four or more. No effective date stated.
sourceFindings.hours: Operator hours page has images but no published text hours; homepage directs visitors to current Google listing. Municipal page says daily 11:00–17:30 without effective date; insufficient for dated production schedule.
sourceFindings.ageAndHeight: Secondary sources mention passenger from age three and solo from age eight with 135 cm, but operator did not publish these rules on the accessible pages reviewed.
sourceFindings.identity: Petersberg near Halle, Saxony-Anhalt. Distinct from Freizeitzentrum Peterberg in Saarland.
